details: Bitcoin tested the $75,000 range and Ethereum fell below $2,400 on September 15-16, amidst a broader crypto market sell-off. This downturn is attributed to high expectations for a 25-basis-point interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve's September 15-16 meeting and increased regulatory uncertainty following the US Senate's failure to advance the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act. Despite the general decline, niche sectors like GameFi and Arbitrum showed relative strength.
title: Crypto Markets Dip as Fed Meeting Looms, CLARITY Act Stalls

details: Despite recent price fluctuations, the Ethereum network's base layer processed a record 203.9 million swaps in Q2 2026, reaching a new all-time high speed of 25.9 trades per second. Additionally, Ether products attracted over $121 million in inflows on September 14, with BlackRock contributing a significant portion, indicating continued institutional interest.
sourceName: openPR.com (citing Wu Blockchain via CoinGabbar and CryptoTimes)
title: Ethereum Network Usage Hits Record High Amidst ETF Inflows
